notes.title: Perseus: Titan Slayer - Update 5
notes.content:
- Added a new gameplay mode; Automated Survivor, you only need to move your character, your attacks and abilities will be automated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43097433/dc41956cc018156e168329f35d9dc2631545c1bf.png[/img]

- Added more presistent upgrades to the ShardsKeeper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43097433/b7bfbd795eed2d9a3bea170f93fa5ad027513651.png[/img]

- Added a save system for the dungeon crawler mode, the game will auto save once you travel or if you click F5, doesn't work in Immortal Ascension.

- Increased the efficiency of luck elixirs and reduced their cost.

- Most abilities now can be cast while moving.

If you experience any bugs after the new changes, post them here.

notes.title: Perseus: Titan Slayer - Update 4
notes.content:
- Killing bosses will now grant you their unique passive skills instead of a choice of active abilities.

This is an example of the dragon ability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43097433/5c16cdfb204e5498dd887e36f66c06ca47a90363.gif[/img]

- Fixed a bug with higher ascensions being reset if the player chooses to play on a lower ascension.

- Increased the amount of gained skill points and gold.

notes.title: Perseus: Titan Slayer - Hotfix
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug with WASD movement being stuck while casting specific abilities like Katana Spin.
- Dash direction will now depend on WASD buttons and not the direction your character is facing, if you are using WASD for movement.
- Fixed a bug with ESC button not working in Survivor mode.
- Removed the experimental legacy controls.

notes.title: Perseus: Titan Slayer - Update 3
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug with WASD controls when you try to attack and move at the same time, resulting in a wrong turn.

- Fixed a bug with WASD controls where the character doesn't aim at the mouse cursor while moving.

- Added [b]Legacy Controls[/b], these are experimental, to activate them, go to Options > Controls > Legacy.
Legacy controls are for WASD movement only. The difference is that now you can attack while moving and dashing direction will depend on WASD buttons and not the vector you are facing.

- Added an X button to close the inventory in case you get stuck there.

- Fixed a bug where character conversation would overlap with choosing a new ability.

- Added the missing treasure reward to one of the maps.

- Added visual values to the health and mana bars.

- Late bosses will drop a tier 4 gem instead of a new ability.

notes.title: Perseus: Titan Slayer - Update 2
notes.content:
- Slightly Increased player base attack and move speed.
- Improved player rotation rate.
- Zoomed the camera out a little bit.
- Reduced Dash cooldown and added an addtional charge to level 3 dash.
- Reduced the attack damage of early game enemies.

notes.title: Perseus: Titan Slayer - Update
notes.content:
- Reduced the cost of Elixirs and Gems in the shopkeeper.
- Increased the effectiveness of the luck elixirs.
- Moved the Abyss Keeper boss landing location slightly away from the player to avoid sending the player off the map.
- Reduced the amount of gained shards at the end of the run.

notes.title: Perseus: Titan Slayer Demo - Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Fixed controls issue being set to None, if you had this issue before this update click on the Reset button at bottom of Options > Controls to reset the controls to default, if the issue still persists report in this post.
- Reduced the enemy death particle size.
- Lowered the prices of the shopkeeper.
- Fixed an issue with enemies in higher ascensions dealing massive damage.
- Fixed an issue with ability level up while pressing Space Bar.
- Increased the effectiveness of some of the consumables.
- Fixed an issue with minimap being disappeared.
- Fixed an issue where you can have 3 skill points at the starting level.
- Increased the amount of gained shards.
